prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Professional Japanese 2D visual-novel PRODUCTION DETAIL SHEET on a uniform warm very pale grey OPAQUE background. Match Image 1 exactly for colors, shapes and simplified low-noise cel rendering. Clean dark line, large flat colors, one hard shadow per material. Show separate isolated orthographic detail drawings with generous spacing; no full-body character, invisible mannequin, scenery or effects. NO text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, logos or watermarks.
DETAILS: low ponytail tie and chest diamond badge, coat front/back and muted-red lining, forearm/shin plates, straight sword front/side and scabbard.
EXACT RULES: One slim straight silver one-handed sword 95 cm long with a plain symmetric silver crossguard, navy leather grip and small round pommel; no blue flame and no large gem. One plain navy scabbard at HER LEFT hip. RIGHT-handed. Guards are practical simple plates, not ornate spikes.
HARD LOCKS: 银白低马尾; 灰紫眼; 白外套蓝长裤; 银菱胸徽1枚; 右手直剑左腰鞘; 无冠. Every physical object appears once; front/back/side or open/closed views are alternate views of the same item. No extra decorative filler.
